__unreviewed-draft: DRAFT capture config, machine-generated from the static extract pass. Review every "__review:*" field (they mark what the tool could NOT infer), fix the values, DELETE each marker you have reviewed, then delete THIS key. The capture runner refuses any config still carrying this key — draft is not approved.

library.__review:version: detected from package.json, NOT confirmed — the harness must carry ds-contracts-poc@1.0.0-rc.1 exactly (the runner refuses version drift)
library.__review:classPrefix: CSS class prefix stripped for part naming/signatures (Polaris uses "Polaris-"); "" keeps full class names
library.__review:classAllow: OPTIONAL regex of class names KEPT in captured signatures — required for hashed/atomic class systems (StyleX keeps only its stable per-component class; Tailwind uses "^$" to keep none); absent keeps every class (CSS-Modules behavior)
library.__review:varPrefix: OPTIONAL custom-property prefix for the CSS-vars source-binding reader ("--mui-" for Emotion cssVariables themes, "--" for Tailwind v4); absent = reader off — pixels stay correct, token NAMES degrade to literals (docs/16 graceful degradation)

mount.__review:mount: the mount recipe the library needs on EVERY stage — stylesheet import (Tailwind: the built CSS, inlined by the harness), ThemeProvider/locale wrappers (MUI: createTheme({cssVariables:true})); see extract/computed/configs/{mui,tailwind}.json for worked examples

tokens.__review:tokens: dtcg prefilled from the extract config (empty = none found — build a DTCG token file first); "css" must point at the stylesheet that defines those tokens as custom properties
